adminHome.reviewText: Confirm the automatic drawing checklist, score the judgement items from 0 to 3 and finalize the result.
adminHome.questionsText: Answer students' questions about their results and about lessons. The student gets an email with your answer.

queue.title: Drawing review queue
queue.purpose: Drawings and trainer tasks waiting for your decision, oldest first. Aim to clear each one within 24 hours.
queue.help: Our system checks drawing standards automatically. You confirm or change each item, score the judgement items and finalize. The student's score is provisional until you do.

unavailable.title: The review queue is not available
unavailable.body: The server is missing its database key. Ask the site owner to check SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

not_set_up.title: The review queue is being set up
not_set_up.body: The database tables are not ready yet. Please try again after the CAD Champions migrations have run.

error.title: We couldn't load the queue
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Reload the page in a minute.

queue.unclearHelp: Submissions where the AI was unsure about at least one item, or could not check the file at all.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.body: All drawings are reviewed. New submissions appear here as soon as students submit a test.

emptyFiltered.title: No submissions match these filters
emptyFiltered.body: Try another test, or clear the filters to see everything that is waiting.

skipped.ai_not_configured: AI check off: no API key
skipped.no_ai_items: No AI items on this task
skipped.no_pdf_in_package: No PDF for this task in the package
skipped.invalid_output: AI answer could not be read

screen.title: Review: {task}
screen.purpose: Check the drawing, confirm or change each checklist item, score the judgement items from 0 to 3, then finalize. The student is emailed when the whole test is final.

not_found.title: This submission was not found
not_found.body: It may have been removed. Go back to the queue and pick another one.

unavailable.title: Reviews are not available
unavailable.body: The server is missing its database key. Ask the site owner to check SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

not_set_up.title: Reviews are being set up
not_set_up.body: The database tables are not ready yet. Please try again after the CAD Champions migrations have run.

error.title: We couldn't load this submission
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Reload the page in a minute.

aiSkipped.ai_not_configured: Off (no API key): check every item by hand
aiSkipped.no_ai_items: No AI items on this task
aiSkipped.file_missing: File not found: check by hand
aiSkipped.no_pdf_in_package: No PDF for this task in the package
aiSkipped.not_pdf: Not a PDF: check by hand
aiSkipped.too_large: PDF over 20 MB: check by hand
aiSkipped.too_many_pages: PDF over 5 pages: check by hand
aiSkipped.invalid_output: AI answer unreadable: check by hand
aiSkipped.api_error: AI service error: check by hand

screen.finalizedBody: You can change your decisions and finalize again. The change is recorded in the audit log.

viewer.title: Drawing
viewer.help: The drawing opens in your browser's own PDF viewer. Use the zoom buttons or the page box here, or the viewer's own controls. Evidence page links jump to the page the AI mentions.
viewer.noPdf: This submission has no PDF we can show here. Download the file below and open it on your computer.

files.title: Files
files.help: Native CAD files, renders and animations are stored for your judgement only. They are never opened or run on our server. Download them and open them in your own software.
files.none: No files were uploaded for this task.

rubric.title: Checklist
rubric.help: Each item shows what the AI decided, how sure it was and what it saw. Tap Pass or Fail to confirm or change it. Score judgement items from 0 to 3. Items the AI was unsure about are marked in amber.
rubric.empty: This task has no marking items. Add them in the test builder.
rubric.measurementAi: Pass or fail · AI first pass

scale.2: Meets the standard and exceeds it in some respects

comment.title: Comment for the student (optional)
comment.hint: Write in English or Arabic. You can add a machine translation to the other language and edit it before you finalize.
comment.label: Comment in {lang}
comment.translated: Translation added. Check it before you finalize.
comment.notConfigured: Translation is off: no Anthropic API key is set.
comment.translateError: We couldn't translate this comment. Try again, or write the other language yourself.
comment.machineHint: Students see this text labelled as machine-translated.

finalize.title: Finalize
finalize.ready: Every item is decided. Finalize to save the score.
finalize.missing: {count} items still need your decision. We moved you to the first one.
finalize.toastGraded: The test is now final and the student is emailed.
finalize.toastProvisional: Other tasks of this test still wait for a trainer.
finalize.doneEmailed: The score is final and the student has been emailed.
finalize.doneGraded: The score is final. The student sees it on their results page.
finalize.doneProvisional: This task is final. The student is emailed once every task of the test is reviewed.

errors.forbidden: Only trainers and admins can finalize reviews.
errors.not_found: This submission no longer exists. Go back to the queue.
errors.not_reviewable: This task has no file to review.
errors.incomplete: Some items still need your decision.
errors.too_long: The comment is too long. Keep it under 2,000 characters.
errors.unavailable: The server is missing its database key. Ask the site owner.
errors.error: We couldn't save the review. Nothing was changed. Try again.

questions.title: Questions inbox
questions.purpose: Questions about results and lessons in one list. Your reply is emailed to the student and shown on their page.
questions.help: Grade questions come from "Question this result" on the results page. Lesson questions come from the lesson pages. Answered lesson questions can be shown to every student.

unavailable.title: The inbox is not available
unavailable.body: The server is missing its database key. Ask the site owner to check SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

not_set_up.title: The inbox is being set up
not_set_up.body: The database tables are not ready yet. Please try again after the CAD Champions migrations have run.

error.title: We couldn't load the questions
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Reload the page in a minute.

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.body: When a student asks about a result or a lesson, the question appears here.

emptyFiltered.title: No questions match these filters
emptyFiltered.body: Clear the filters to see every question.

reply.label: Your answer
reply.hint: Answer in the student's language if you can. They get an email with your answer and a button to their page.
reply.sentNoEmail: We couldn't email the student, but they see the answer on their page.
reply.tooLong: The answer is too long. Keep it under 4,000 characters.
reply.error: We couldn't save the answer. Try again.

public.label: Show to everyone
public.help: The question and your answer appear under the lesson for every student, without the student's name. Only answered lesson questions can be shown.
public.needsAnswer: Answer the question before you show it to everyone.
public.error: We couldn't change this setting. Try again.

student.checklistHelp: Our system checked the drawing standards automatically. A trainer will confirm and check your dimensions within 48 hours.

scale.2: Meets the standard and exceeds it in some respects

student.answerPending: A trainer will answer soon. We'll email you.
